card.name: Study-design words before study or animal terms
card.fires_on: Small words and numbers that come right before a study type or animal species, such as 'end of study', 'In two-year studies', 'in mice and rats' or 'long-term, open-label'. They appear in trial and toxicology sections.

modes.label: Study duration or design
modes.description: A number, 'open' or 'of' that leads into a study description such as a two-year or open-label study.

modes.description: A linking word just before rats, mice or male and female rats in toxicology text.
